verdicts.reason: A breaks the design's logic: the yellow circle has come loose from the phone and sits behind the headline. The tiny centred logo clashes with the left-aligned headline, the subcopy leaves 'rest.' alone on its own line, the badges have fallen below the CTA, and the two badges are visibly different sizes (AUDIO COACHING is tiny, NO GEAR is large). B keeps the original's split layout, hierarchy and phone-in-circle motif with no collisions. Its flaws: the logo (x≈55) and CTA (x≈33) don't line up with the text column (x≈25), and about 140px of empty space sits at the bottom.
